$comment: Criterion 7: every synthesis-failed finding in the committed fixtures, with the reason its schema admits no value. A synthesis-failed finding at a pointer not listed here fails the test, and so does a listed one that is not reported. A fixture listed with [] is expected to have none; if the engine reports one there, a person decides whether the schema truly admits no value and either adds it here with a written reason or fixes the synthesizer. Fetch-only fixtures (large/) are not listed: m1.md says nobody reviews their reasons. Fatal fixtures build nothing and are not listed. Pointer: the schema whose synthesized value has errors (ADR 0003 'Schema validation'; ADR 0004 rule table: 'at the schema').

qa/unsatisfiable-schemas.yaml.reason: An integer at least 10 and at most 5: the range is empty.
A string of at least 5 and at most 2 code points: no length satisfies both.
'not: {}': the empty schema accepts every value, so its negation accepts none.
allOf of type string and type integer: no JSON value is both a string and an integer.
An integer between 3 and 3 inclusive is 3, which is not a multiple of 2.
An integer strictly greater than 0 and strictly less than 1: there is none.
const is the number 5 and type is string: the only value const allows has the wrong type.
oneOf of two identical string schemas: a string matches both, so not exactly one; any other value matches neither.
Property 'a' is required, but no property is declared and additionalProperties is false, so 'a' is not allowed.
An array of at least 3 and at most 1 items: no length satisfies both.
At least 2 items, each equal to 'only', and all unique: two items would be equal.
